it.title: Trotta: "De Bruyne? Deve assecondare le richieste! Se Allegri ti chiede di giocare da difensore centrale, tu giochi altrimenti manchi di rispetto a lui e compagni"
it.description: A “1 Football Club”, programma radiofonico in onda su 1 Station Radio, è intervenuto Ivano Trotta, allenatore ed ex calciatore di Napoli e Juventus. Di seguito, un estratto dell’intervista. In Europa, le italiane stanno facendo fatica. Quattro squadre impegnate in Champions e risultati che fanno riflettere. È un segnale negativo? Un altro dato curioso è che tre delle quattro squadre italiane, tra cui Napoli e Roma, hanno gestito male il vantaggio. "Sicuramente il Napoli è incappato in un errore che, soprattutto in trasferta, può cambiare la storia di una partita. In Champions League gli errori si pagano, e si pagano a caro prezzo. Detto questo, le rimonte subite non devono necessariamente diventare un campanello d'allarme: ogni anno si ripete che la Champions League è un'altra cosa. Spero che tutte le italiane facciano tesoro di queste partite e prestino maggiore attenzione nelle prossime gare." Dalle prestazioni ed i continui cambi di assetto tattico sembra che il Napoli abbia una crisi d’identità: è così? "Sono d'accordo solo in parte. Secondo me, questa volta il Napoli non ha disputato una partita pessima, quindi non me la sento di criticarlo su tutti i fronti. Allegri sta gestendo un gruppo che non è stato costruito e formato da lui, e questo non è semplice. Giocare una partita importante in Spagna, contro il Villarreal, in uno stadio con il pubblico così vicino al campo, non è facile. Andare in vantaggio era importante, ma il modo in cui è arrivato il pareggio ha inevitabilmente abbassato un po' l'autostima della squadra. Non credo che sia tutto da buttare, soprattutto per quanto riguarda il Napoli. Bisogna però invertire la rotta: se i risultati non arrivano, è evidente che qualcosa debba cambiare." Per quanto De Bruyne sia stato e sia un grandissimo calciatore, nessun giocatore può essere più grande del club. È lui che deve mettersi a disposizione di Allegri o viceversa?"No, questo è giusto: lui deve assecondare le richieste del mister. In passato, anche guardando le sue esperienze precedenti, è capitato che avesse qualcosa da ridire su determinate posizioni, anche con Guardiola. È un giocatore dal carattere forte, questo si è capito. La sua carriera, però, parla per lui: è stato ed è un campione, un calciatore di livello superiore. Come hai detto giustamente, nessun campione può essere al di sopra delle gerarchie di un club. La gerarchia più importante è quella della società e, in campo, è l'allenatore a decidere. Se Allegri ti chiede di giocare da difensore centrale, tu giochi da difensore centrale. Non rispettare le indicazioni dell'allenatore significa mancare di rispetto non soltanto a lui, ma anche ai compagni e al club stesso. Non so nello specifico che cosa si siano detti e che cosa sia successo, ma, se la domanda è se un giocatore debba rispettare le indicazioni dell'allenatore, la risposta è assolutamente sì. De Bruyne deve essere un po' più disponibile nei confronti di Allegri e delle sue richieste. L'anno scorso, inoltre, è rimasto a lungo fuori per un grave infortunio, e in alcune partite si è visto quanto possa fare la differenza quando è al meglio. È normale che un giocatore non possa essere sempre al top, ma il club deve venire prima di tutto."

mx.title: Hermosillo acuerda suministro de agua tratada para La Manga
mx.description: Después de décadas de incertidumbre sobre el aprovechamiento del agua, las familias del ejido La Manga acordaron con el Ayuntamiento de Hermosillo un esquema de suministro de agua tratada para actividades productivas como la ganadería y la agricultura. El presidente municipal, Antonio Astiazarán Gutiérrez, firmó un convenio de participación con representantes ejidales, mediante el cual la comunidad aportará una hectárea de terreno para la construcción de una planta tratadora, a cambio de recibir 240 litros por segundo de agua tratada. En el acuerdo participaron Renato Ulloa Valdez, director general de Agua de Hermosillo; Lisette López, coordinadora distrital; y Rebeca Meza Dessens, presidenta del Consejo de Vigilancia del Ejido La Manga. Astiazarán señaló que el convenio busca dar certidumbre a las familias sobre la disponibilidad del recurso, al tiempo que permitirá al organismo operador contar con un espacio para construir infraestructura destinada al tratamiento y aprovechamiento de aguas residuales. El proyecto contempla un esquema de pago gradual vinculado a la aportación de los ejidatarios y busca atender las necesidades actuales y futuras de una zona en desarrollo. La Manga arrastra una demanda desde los años noventa Rebeca Meza Dessens y Manuel Guadalupe Arvallo Burruel, presidente del Ejido La Manga, expusieron los antecedentes de la demanda de la comunidad, que se remonta a la década de los noventa. De acuerdo con los representantes ejidales, en aquel periodo la comunidad cedió 430 hectáreas con la promesa de construir una planta tratadora en Los Bagotes. Sin embargo, el proyecto no se concretó y los habitantes continuaron buscando certeza sobre el aprovechamiento del agua. Con el nuevo convenio, el Ayuntamiento y Agua de Hermosillo buscan establecer condiciones para reutilizar el agua tratada en actividades productivas, una alternativa relevante ante las condiciones de aridez y la necesidad de diversificar las fuentes de abastecimiento en la capital sonorense. El Gobierno municipal señaló que continuará trabajando con las comunidades para promover el aprovechamiento responsable del recurso hídrico y atender las necesidades asociadas al crecimiento de Hermosillo.

mx.title: Congreso de Sonora aprueba cuentas públicas de 2025
mx.description: El Congreso de Sonora aprobó por mayoría las cuentas públicas estatal y municipales correspondientes al ejercicio fiscal 2025. Sin embargo, cuatro entes públicos estatales no obtuvieron calificación aprobatoria y las cuentas de ocho municipios fueron rechazadas. Durante la sesión de este jueves 15 de octubre, el diputado Raúl González de la Vega, del Partido Verde Ecologista de México (PVEM), presentó el dictamen de la Comisión de Fiscalización sobre la cuenta pública estatal, elaborado con base en el informe de resultados del Instituto Superior de Auditoría y Fiscalización (ISAF). De acuerdo con el dictamen, se aprobó la gestión financiera de 88 entes públicos estatales. No obstante, la Comisión Estatal del Agua (CEA), el Fideicomiso Puente Colorado, el Instituto de Seguridad y Servicios Sociales de los Trabajadores del Estado de Sonora (Isssteson) y la Universidad de Sonora (Unison) no obtuvieron una calificación aprobatoria. La aprobación generó posturas encontradas entre los grupos parlamentarios. Morena, el Partido del Trabajo (PT), el PVEM, el Partido Encuentro Solidario (PES) y Nueva Alianza Sonora (NAS), así como la diputada Alejandra López Noriega, respaldaron la cuenta pública estatal y destacaron la estabilidad financiera, además de la inversión en programas sociales, educación, salud e infraestructura. En contraste, las bancadas del Partido Revolucionario Institucional (PRI) y Movimiento Ciudadano (MC), así como las representaciones del Partido Acción Nacional (PAN) y el Partido de la Revolución Democrática (PRD), cuestionaron las irregularidades detectadas, el posible daño patrimonial y el aumento de la deuda pública. También exigieron mayor transparencia y seguimiento a las observaciones. Ocho municipios no aprueban sus cuentas públicas En cuanto a las cuentas públicas municipales, el diputado Sebastián Antonio Orduño Fragoza, de Morena, presentó el dictamen correspondiente a los ayuntamientos. El Congreso aprobó las cuentas de 64 municipios, mientras que las de Bácum, Benjamín Hill, Huatabampo, Naco, Oquitoa, Pitiquito, Sáric y Yécora no fueron aprobadas y se remitieron al órgano fiscalizador para su seguimiento. Congreso remite reforma de protección civil para su publicación En la misma sesión, el Poder Legislativo acordó remitir al Ejecutivo estatal la Ley Número 161, que reforma y adiciona diversas disposiciones de la Constitución Política de Sonora en materia de gestión integral de riesgos y protección civil, para continuar con el procedimiento de publicación en el Boletín Oficial del Gobierno del Estado. Además, el Congreso aprobó la convocatoria del Parlamento para la Inclusión de Personas con Discapacidad 2026, dirigido a residentes de Sonora con discapacidad. La recepción de propuestas estará abierta del 19 de octubre al 2 de noviembre. La celebración del parlamento está programada para el 4 de diciembre en San Carlos, Guaymas.

BARMM starts new era with coalition-led govt
ph.description: ZAMBOANGA CITY — The Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) stands on the verge of its most consequential structural shift since its creation, when 80 newly elected Members of Parliament (MPs) prepare to take their oaths at noon on Oct. 30, marking the end of its transitional era and a step into five years of democratic governance through June 2031. The formal consolidation of a 46-seat majority coalition led by the Bangsamoro Federalist Party (BFP) not only resolves post-election uncertainty but also sets out a clear roadmap for what the public can expect from the region’s first regular parliamentary government. The immediate impact of the BFP-led majority, which brings together 31 BFP members alongside allied district and party-list MPs from the United Bangsamoro Justice Party (UBJP), the BARMM Grand Coalition (BGC), and regional parties like the Serbisyong Inklusibo and Alyansang Progresibo Party, is political predictability. Having cleared the 41-seat threshold needed to elect the regular Chief Minister and organize the “Government of the Day,” the incoming administration led by expected or projected Chief Minister Abdulraof “Sammy Gambar” Macacua eliminates the risk of legislative gridlock during its initial term. During a four-day strategic planning session in Davao City that kicked off on Oct. 11 and ran through Oct. 14, coalition leaders vowed that the new government will move quickly to evaluate the performance of the outgoing interim Bangsamoro Transition Authority (BTA). “The Bangsamoro Transition Authority opened the door. Some of its gains were real. Some of its failures were real, too,” Macacua told parliamentarians, framing the government’s mandate as an audit of transitional performance designed to refine public spending and eliminate bureaucratic bottlenecks rather than execute political reprisals. Front and center on the legislative agenda is the enactment of the regional expenditure program, which will determine the allocation of the multibillion peso annual block grant from the national government. Residents and municipal leaders from BARMM can expect a rapid execution of legislative priorities within the administration’s first 100 days. The incoming executive lineup, projected to include veteran policymakers like MP-elect Naguib Sinarimbo in key portfolios, will focus heavily on local government unit (LGU) convergence. Municipalities across Maguindanao, Lanao del Sur, and the Special Geographic Area (SGA) can anticipate direct ministerial assistance for local infrastructure, healthcare expansion, and disaster response modernization. The political legitimacy of the incoming administration is further bolstered by explicit recognition from Malacañang. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. reaffirmed national support for the 46-member majority coalition, signaling smooth cooperation between the national capital and Cotabato City. Community leaders and civil society groups expect the new parliament to foster an inclusive environment that respects multiethnic representation. By bringing together leaders from diverse political backgrounds, the coalition aims to bridge historical political divides between mainland Moro populations, island communities, and Indigenous peoples (IPs). With security forces maintaining high operational readiness across Western Mindanao and the transition steering committees finalizing internal rules, regional authorities report that all arrangements are complete.

ph.title: Megaworld targeting 1M sqm of mall space
ph.description: MEGAWORLD Corp. is targeting 1 million square meters (sqm) of retail gross leasable area by 2030, with plans to build new lifestyle malls in four areas and expand its existing portfolio under newly appointed Megaworld Lifestyle Malls head Javier Hernandez. The property developer plans to break ground on new malls in Cavite, Rizal, Pampanga and Bacolod City between 2026 and 2027 as it expands its retail presence across its townships, the company said on Thursday. Megaworld, a subsidiary of conglomerate Alliance Global Group Inc., also plans to explore new retail and commercial formats over the next five years to accommodate changing consumer preferences and provide more opportunities for retail partners. Hernandez succeeds Graham Coates, who led the lifestyle mall business for eight years. He brings more than 30 years of experience in property development, retail, hospitality and tourism, including about two decades in mall operations and management. “As we work toward our target, our focus will be on growing the business responsibly while continuing to strengthen our existing destinations,” Hernandez said. He added that the company would focus on improving customer experience, introducing new retail concepts and developing formats that would complement the growth of Megaworld’s townships. Megaworld Lifestyle Malls currently operates 27 lifestyle malls nationwide. Its recent developments include the Imperial Wing at Lucky Chinatown and The Shoppes at McKinley West, while Eastwood Mall has undergone redevelopment. Under Coates, the company also brought Tesla’s first Philippine Experience Center to Uptown Bonifacio and expanded international retail brands KKV and Nitori across its townships. Its entertainment offerings include Uptown Tempur Cinema and the REP Eastwood Theater, the permanent home of Repertory Philippines. Alliance Global President and CEO Kevin Tan said Hernandez plans to expand the business while bringing in international brands and creating more opportunities for Filipino retailers. The planned mall openings form part of Megaworld’s broader effort to expand the retail component of its township developments, which combine commercial spaces with residential, office and leisure facilities. Megaworld shares on Thursday added P0.03, or 1.36 percent, to close at P2.23 each amid a 0.82-percent rise for the benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange index.

ph.title: UPS opens new $80M hub in Clark
ph.description: UNITED Parcel Service (UPS) has opened a new $80-million (about P5.04 billion) international air hub at Clark Airport in Pampanga as the logistics company continues to further expand operations in Asia-Pacific and strengthen its services across more than 1,000 global trade lanes. Measuring 30,000 square meters, the new hub is 15 times larger than the first Clark facility UPS established in 2002, enabling a ninefold increase in average daily handling capacity to 46,000 packages from around 5,000 before. Maximum processing capacity is seen going up 12 times to 15,000 packages per hour from 1,250 packages previously. “With this new expansion, UPS is now able to enhance its service for pickup times and transit times to over 1,100 freight lanes. And the biggest beneficiary of that is not just the Philippines, but also our global customer base,” UPS Clark International Hub General Manager Albert Sapaen Jr. told a media briefing late Tuesday. UPS President for Asia-Pacific Operations and Strategy Daryl Tay said: “Asia continues to be central, I would say, as an engine for growth. If you look at China, it will continue to be a major powerhouse in manufacturing.” “And if we look at shifts in trends, customers around the world look at having more supply chain resilience, and it leads to them looking at how do they reconfigure their supply chains,” he added. “And as a result, I would say there are opportunities for us to invest more in Asia-Pacific not just for the short term but also for the longer term as well.” The new hub houses three refrigeration and freezer units with a range of from minus 20 Celsius to 25 Celsius, dedicated re-icing capability and UPS Premier RFID technology to provide priority handling and enhanced visibility for critical and temperature-sensitive health care shipments. It also features an automated sorting system using smart technology to process up to 9,000 small packages per hour. Its ramp operations use a fleet of electric ground servicing equipment, including cargo tractors, belt and cargo loaders, ground processing units and forklifts. UPS said the Clark hub represents one of its latest network and facility enhancements across Asia-Pacific.

ph.title: Cebu overall inflation slows down in Sept
ph.description: CEBU CITY — Rising food prices continued to squeeze household budgets in Cebu province in September, even as slower increases in transport costs pulled overall inflation down to 9.2 percent from 9.5 percent in August. Chief Statistical Specialist Felixberto Sato Jr. of the Cebu Provincial Statistical Office presented the latest Consumer Price Index and inflation figures for all-income households in Cebu province and its major cities during a press conference Monday. Despite the month-on-month slowdown, provincial inflation remained well above the 5.3 percent recorded in September 2025. Transport inflation eased to 13.5 percent in September from 17.6 percent in August, accounting for 98.4 percent of the deceleration in the province’s overall inflation rate. Food and non-alcoholic beverages remained the biggest contributor to price increases, with inflation reaching 10.7 percent and adding 4.72 percentage points to the provincial rate. Housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuels ranked second, posting 6.6-percent inflation and contributing 1.29 percentage points. For households in the bottom 30-percent income group, inflation slowed to 10.9 percent from 11.5 percent in August. Transport inflation for this group declined to 14.5 percent, while food inflation reached 12.2 percent. The slowdown in provincial inflation did not extend to Cebu’s three major cities, where prices rose at a faster pace. Cebu City’s inflation climbed to 8.4 percent in September from 7.5 percent in August, more than doubling the 3.1 percent recorded a year earlier. Food and non-alcoholic beverages accounted for 71.9 percent of the city’s inflation uptrend, with the category’s inflation rate reaching 9.3 percent. Transport inflation also accelerated to 15.2 percent. Mandaue City recorded 6.8-percent inflation, up from 5.9 percent in August, as restaurants and accommodation services drove much of the increase. Inflation in the category jumped to 18.7 percent from 9.3 percent, accounting for 88.6 percent of the city’s upward movement. In Lapu-Lapu City, inflation rose to a revised 5.0 percent in September from 4.2 percent in August. Vegetables, tubers and related products remained a major source of food price pressure across the province. Inflation in the category reached 31.8 percent in Cebu province and 41.5 percent in Mandaue City. Rice inflation stood at 8.5 percent across Cebu province, while Cebu City recorded a sharper 21.1-percent increase. Corn inflation in the province eased to 11.0 percent, although Lapu-Lapu City registered an increase to 8.8 percent. Nationally, inflation accelerated to 7.2 percent in September, adding to pressure on consumers and businesses as rising prices eroded purchasing power. Economist Emmanuel Leyco warned in a news report that persistent inflation could weaken the peso’s appeal to investors despite the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas’ 5-percent benchmark interest rate. Leyco urged the government to consider suspending excise taxes on domestic fuel products to ease costs. He also proposed tax holidays for small businesses struggling with higher operating expenses.

bd.title: Born to Be Open: RoboParty Launches RP1, a Full-Stack Open-Source Humanoid
bd.description: SHANGHAI, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- RoboParty today officially launches RP1 (ROBOTO 01), a high-performance, full-stack open-source humanoid robot designed for advanced robotics research and embodied AI development. With open access to both hardware and software, RP1 enables researchers to customize the system, integrate their own algorithms, and test new approaches on real hardware. RP1 traversing obstacles, real-world photograph As AI increasingly moves into the physical world, humanoid robots are becoming a key platform for the next generation of embodied intelligence. But if their core technologies remain hidden inside black boxes, will innovation be defined only by the few who have access to the underlying systems? The future of embodied AI should not be built on technological black boxes. Every researcher and developer should have the opportunity to participate. AI models continue to advance, yet the physical systems that bring their capabilities into the real world still face significant limitations. For robotics researchers, closed hardware and low-level control systems restrict experimental flexibility and system innovation. For embodied AI developers, limited visibility into a robot's internal behavior makes it difficult to pinpoint problems across model policies, control systems and hardware execution. RP1 addresses these limitations by opening access to its robot body design and technical resources for RoboParty's in-house-developed ROMOMO joint actuator modules, alongside technical documentation and research materials. Together, these resources establish an open development ecosystem encompassing mechanical structures, actuators, motion control, simulation environments, software development kits (SDKs) and training tools. RP1 component showcase Full-Stack Open Source Across Hardware and Software Open-source robotics should extend beyond software interfaces. To advance humanoid robotics research, developers need to understand, modify and validate the physical systems that underpin intelligent behavior. RP1 was built around this principle. At the hardware level, RP1 integrates RoboParty's in-house-developed ROMOMO joint actuator modules with an optimized mechanical structure and motion-control architecture. Its low-level drivers and control algorithms are also fully open source, with the software stack extending to firmware, development tools, simulation resources and robot learning frameworks. Access to hardware designs and underlying technologies allows researchers to explore the relationships among mechanical design, joint response, control behavior and learning policies. Researchers can go beyond sending commands to a fixed robot platform. They can analyze and modify the underlying systems that determine how the robot executes movement. When a robot fails to perform an intended action accurately, the cause may lie in the model, control policy, actuator response or mechanical structure. An open development ecosystem enables researchers to trace problems across these layers and optimize them together, with access to systems they can inspect and modify. True open source extends beyond code to the robot itself, putting full control of the system in developers' hands. Designed to Adapt to Research Needs The standard RP1 stands approximately 1.3 meters tall and features 24 actuated degrees of freedom (DoF), supporting research into gait, balance control and sim-to-real transfer. The Pro version features 30 actuated DoF, including a 2-DoF neck and two 7-DoF arms, supporting research into end-to-end policies, human-robot interaction and data collection for embodied AI. These DoF counts exclude the dexterous hands. RP1's modular structure and open control interfaces allow research teams to adapt the platform to their experimental needs. Teams can begin with bipedal locomotion research, then configure additional hardware and software for perception, data collection or manipulation experiments. Interchangeable head modules and wrist end effectors support multiple configurations, including RoboParty's in-house-developed RP Hand dexterous hand. These interfaces allow teams to conduct a range of experiments on the same robot platform. Open hardware and software also support controlled experiments. Researchers can compare different control methods on identical hardware or hold the control method constant while examining how hardware configuration changes affect experimental results. Recording hardware versions, software configurations and test conditions helps teams trace the causes of differences in results. Enabling Developers to Focus on Embodied AI Models PartyOS Technology Roadmap RP1 already supports foundational motor capabilities, including continuous walking, recovery from external disturbances, getting back up after a fall and human motion tracking. These capabilities provide an established foundation for embodied AI model development, reducing the need for teams to repeatedly develop low-level motor skills and allowing them to focus on higher-level intelligent policies and complex tasks. For Whole Body Intelligence development, RP1 provides a robot body capable of dynamic motion, whole-body control (WBC), and supporting tools for virtual reality (VR) teleoperation, data collection and playback, and motion retargeting. It also provides integrated development workflows for WBC-based whole-body motion execution, teleoperation using VR or motion-capture devices, and RP Hand control. WBC coordinates the arms, torso and legs to support dynamic motion tracking and posture adjustment, providing a stable motion-execution foundation for tasks that combine locomotion and manipulation. Integrated with RoboParty's in-house-developed PartyOS embodied AI system, the UFO unsupervised reinforcement learning framework and MimicLite motion imitation technology, RP1 supports motor skill learning, control policy development and higher-level applications. RP1 also provides an open toolchain spanning data collection, training in simulation, deployment on physical robots and experimental validation. Researchers can deploy models on the robot, analyze discrepancies between model outputs and actual physical responses, and independently adjust control policies and hardware configurations. This creates a continuous development loop from algorithm development to real-world execution, feedback and refinement. To meet embodied AI development requirements for experimental stability and reproducibility, RP1 incorporates systematic improvements across its mechanical structure, core actuators and manufacturing processes. RoboParty's in-house-developed ROMOMO actuators, structural optimization and manufacturing quality management are designed to improve consistency in physical response, overall reliability and maintainability. These measures help minimize the influence of hardware variation on experimental results and provide a stable physical platform for repeated model training and validation over extended periods. Building a Shared Foundation for Global Innovation RoboParty launched the RPO open-source project in January 2026, releasing mechanical and electrical design resources, along with training and deployment materials. The project has garnered more than 2,600 GitHub stars, enabling developers to reproduce and extend the robot design using publicly available resources. RP1 continues this open-source approach, bringing together ROMOMO joint actuator modules, research from RoboParty Lab and the ongoing development of PartyOS to expand the technology foundation for robotics research and embodied AI model development. "We believe the future of embodied AI should not be defined by just a handful of closed systems," said Yi Huang, founder of RoboParty. "With RP1, we want to open up more than code. We want to give researchers the opportunity to truly understand, modify and continuously advance robotic capabilities. When more teams can innovate on a shared technical foundation, the entire industry can move further forward." RoboParty's vision is to make the future of embodied AI open to everyone ready to explore it. ae.title: AIMCONNECT 2026 Held in Singapore, Bringing Global Automotive Leaders Together to Explore the Future of AI, Trust and Connected Mobility
ae.description: SINGAPORE – Media OutReach Newswire – 15 October 2026 – Held on 11 October 2026 at Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa in Singapore, AIMCONNECT 2026 gathered industry leaders from 11 countries under the theme "Where Mobility Meets the Future." Organised by X Star Technology and Aimotion, the event welcomed representatives from more than 100 automotive organisations, over 60 financial institutions and around 20 technology companies to explore how collaboration across industries can create a more connected mobility ecosystem. https://youtu.be/sbUyQWx8ItQ The event was opened by Tin Pei Ling, Member of Parliament, and Dato' Tony Khor Chong Boon, President of the Federation of Motor and Credit Companies Associations of Malaysia (FMCCAM). Through keynote presentations, panel discussions and live technology demonstrations, participants examined how AI-driven solutions can improve customer experiences while ensuring transparency, security and responsible decision-making. AIMCONNECT 2026 Highlights the Shift Towards Connected Mobility During the keynote address, "The Next Mobility Economy: Intelligence, Connection, Trust," X Star Technology CEO Shawn Yang highlighted the growing gap between consumers' digital engagement and completed automotive transactions. Shawn Yang noted that consumers increasingly begin their vehicle purchase journey online, with research showing strong demand for AI-supported decision-making. According to figures shared during the keynote, 90% of car buyers conduct online research before visiting dealerships, 63% expect to use AI during their next vehicle purchase and 67% believe AI will influence their financing decisions. However, the automotive journey remains fragmented. Customers often move between dealerships, financing providers and multiple systems, creating unnecessary friction during purchasing and ownership processes. "Customers are not lost in one stage; they are lost to the friction between them," Yang said. Yang said. The CEO explained that the next stage of mobility innovation requires closer cooperation between automotive companies, financial institutions and technology providers. Rather than improving isolated parts of the journey, the industry must create connected experiences that allow information, decisions and services to move more efficiently between stakeholders. During AIMCONNECT 2026, technology demonstrations showcased emerging solutions designed to address these challenges. X Star Technology presented its Xport platform, demonstrating one-click lead-to-loan matching and real-time approval capabilities. Aimotion, MStar, AI Wingman and MK.X also introduced their latest innovations, highlighting the potential of AI-enabled tools across the automotive value chain. Building Trust as AI Takes a Greater Role in Decision-Making A key theme throughout AIMCONNECT 2026 was the importance of trust as artificial intelligence becomes increasingly involved in customer-facing processes. While AI can improve speed and efficiency, industry leaders emphasised that technology must operate within clear boundaries. Decisions involving financing, customer eligibility and financial commitments require transparency, human oversight and accountability. Yang introduced X Star Technology's proprietary Harness framework, which combines AI operating boundaries, human supervision and traceable data management. The framework is designed to ensure that AI systems operate within authorised parameters while allowing complex cases to be escalated for human review. "In auto finance, a single flawed decision risks customer harm and regulatory non-compliance. For AI to operate across the customer journey with true autonomy, trust cannot be an afterthought; it must be engineered into the architecture from day one," Yang said. The discussions also highlighted the importance of balancing personalisation with privacy. While consumers increasingly expect services tailored to their needs, excessive automation or unnecessary intervention may reduce trust. Effective AI solutions must therefore combine intelligence with appropriate restraint. Strengthening Connections Across the Auto Finance Ecosystem Another major discussion at AIMCONNECT 2026 focused on how stronger collaboration between automotive companies, financial institutions and technology providers can create a more efficient and trusted financing experience. During the panel discussion "Building a Connected Auto Finance Ecosystem," moderated by MStar CEO Zhang Peng, industry representatives explored the role of data connectivity, cybersecurity and responsible technology adoption in shaping the future of automotive finance. Speakers from Deloitte, Deutsche Bank, The CEO Circle and JWT Bespoke examined how financial institutions and mobility businesses can use technology to improve decision-making while maintaining customer confidence. "Better data infrastructure and connectivity can help the industry make more informed financing decisions, but technology must go hand in hand with trust," Zhang said. The discussion emphasised that connectivity is not simply about collecting more data. A truly integrated ecosystem requires organisations to establish clear principles for how information is shared, protected and used. Customers must also understand what information they provide and how it contributes to a better service experience. Matthew Duncan, Director and CEO of JWT Bespoke, highlighted the importance of balancing innovation with consumer protection, drawing from Australia's experience in automotive and financial regulation. "Regulation works best when it protects customers and still gives the industry room to improve how people buy and finance their cars," Duncan said. Exploring the Future of Vehicle Ownership Beyond financing and transactions, AIMCONNECT 2026 also examined a broader question facing the mobility industry: how will consumers define vehicle ownership in the future? The rise of leasing, subscription services, car-sharing and ride-hailing has expanded consumer choices, creating new possibilities beyond traditional ownership models. During the panel "The Future of Owning a Car," moderated by Shawn Yang, industry leaders discussed how changing consumer expectations may influence future mobility behaviour. An audience poll showed a closely divided perspective. While 54% of participants believed flexible mobility solutions could become the preferred choice within the next decade, 46% expected vehicle ownership to remain the dominant preference. The result reflected the complexity of future mobility trends. Rather than replacing ownership completely, emerging mobility models may provide consumers with more options depending on their lifestyle, financial situation and travel needs. James Ng, Managing Director of BYD Singapore and President of BYD Philippines, shared insights into BYD's technology development journey. "BYD's first phase was electrification, delivering performance. The second phase is intelligence, using AI to enhance the customer experience. The third phase will focus on integration," Ng said. Xiao Ting, CEO of MK.X, noted that increasingly capable AI assistants could change how consumers approach mobility decisions. "The decision may increasingly be less about owning a car and more about finding the right mobility solution for each journey," noted the CEO. Ng also highlighted the broader applications of BYD's technology beyond vehicles, including Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and renewable energy solutions that contribute to a wider technology ecosystem. These developments suggest that the future mobility landscape will involve not only automakers, but also dealers, financial institutions and technology platforms adapting their services to meet changing consumer expectations. AI Is Expanding the Vehicle Experience Beyond the Point of Sale The role of artificial intelligence throughout the vehicle ownership lifecycle was another key focus at AIMCONNECT 2026. During the panel "How Is AI Reshaping Mobility?" moderated by X Star Chief Technology Officer Michael Jia, industry experts discussed how AI can support consumers beyond vehicle selection and purchase. Panel participants included Carson Zhang of Aimotion, Connor Liu of Google Cloud, Dr Harold Teng of MK.X Technology and Bryan Tan of Carro. When delegates were asked where AI would create the greatest impact, personalised ownership services ranked ahead of vehicle selection, automotive financing and in-car intelligence. The results suggested that industry participants see significant opportunities in improving the ownership experience after purchase. Bryan Tan, Chief Scientist at Carro Group and CEO of Carro Indonesia, explained that vehicle value assessment is becoming increasingly influenced by new data sources. For electric vehicles, factors such as battery condition and charging history are becoming important considerations alongside traditional indicators such as mileage. Tan also noted that markets such as Singapore have unique considerations, including the impact of the Certificate of Entitlement (COE) system on vehicle value. These examples demonstrate how advances in automotive technology are influencing areas beyond driving performance, extending into finance, resale value and long-term ownership decisions. However, industry leaders agreed that AI adoption must remain focused on practical benefits. "The focus must remain on delivering practical benefits, enhancing safety and making mobility more intuitive for consumers," Dr Teng said. Collaboration Will Define the Next Stage of Mobility Innovation Across the discussions at AIMCONNECT 2026, one common message emerged: the future of mobility will be shaped by collaboration. Automotive manufacturers and dealers must better understand customer needs and reduce unnecessary friction throughout the ownership journey. Financial institutions must improve efficiency while maintaining responsible lending practices. Technology providers must develop solutions that meet operational, regulatory and customer expectations. For policymakers and industry stakeholders, the challenge will be encouraging innovation while maintaining public confidence. "No single company can transform the entire mobility journey on its own," Xiao Ting said. Zhang highlighted that the success of future mobility solutions should be measured not only by speed and efficiency, but also by how effectively the industry works together to serve customers. "Progress should be measured not only by how quickly a loan can be approved, but by how well the industry works together to serve the customer," Zhang said. AIMCONNECT 2026 demonstrated that artificial intelligence will play an increasingly important role in mobility, but technology alone will not define the future. The next phase of automotive transformation will depend on building systems that are intelligent, transparent and connected — supported by stronger partnerships across the mobility ecosystem. Through industry dialogue, thought leadership sessions and live technology demonstrations, AIMCONNECT provides a platform for stakeholders to exchange insights and collaborate on the next generation of connected mobility solutions. These capabilities provide an established foundation for embodied AI model development, reducing the need for teams to repeatedly develop low-level motor skills and allowing them to focus on higher-level intelligent policies and complex tasks. For Whole Body Intelligence development, RP1 provides a robot body capable of dynamic motion, whole-body control (WBC), and supporting tools for virtual reality (VR) teleoperation, data collection and playback, and motion retargeting. It also provides integrated development workflows for WBC-based whole-body motion execution, teleoperation using VR or motion-capture devices, and RP Hand control. WBC coordinates the arms, torso and legs to support dynamic motion tracking and posture adjustment, providing a stable motion-execution foundation for tasks that combine locomotion and manipulation. Integrated with RoboParty's in-house-developed PartyOS embodied AI system, the UFO unsupervised reinforcement learning framework and MimicLite motion imitation technology, RP1 supports motor skill learning, control policy development and higher-level applications. RP1 also provides an open toolchain spanning data collection, training in simulation, deployment on physical robots and experimental validation. Researchers can deploy models on the robot, analyze discrepancies between model outputs and actual physical responses, and independently adjust control policies and hardware configurations. This creates a continuous development loop from algorithm development to real-world execution, feedback and refinement. To meet embodied AI development requirements for experimental stability and reproducibility, RP1 incorporates systematic improvements across its mechanical structure, core actuators and manufacturing processes. RoboParty's in-house-developed ROMOMO actuators, structural optimization and manufacturing quality management are designed to improve consistency in physical response, overall reliability and maintainability. These measures help minimize the influence of hardware variation on experimental results and provide a stable physical platform for repeated model training and validation over extended periods. Building a Shared Foundation for Global Innovation RoboParty launched the RPO open-source project in January 2026, releasing mechanical and electrical design resources, along with training and deployment materials. The project has garnered more than 2,600 GitHub stars, enabling developers to reproduce and extend the robot design using publicly available resources. RP1 continues this open-source approach, bringing together ROMOMO joint actuator modules, research from RoboParty Lab and the ongoing development of PartyOS to expand the technology foundation for robotics research and embodied AI model development. "We believe the future of embodied AI should not be defined by just a handful of closed systems," said Yi Huang, founder of RoboParty. "With RP1, we want to open up more than code. We want to give researchers the opportunity to truly understand, modify and continuously advance robotic capabilities. When more teams can innovate on a shared technical foundation, the entire industry can move further forward." RoboParty's vision is to make the future of embodied AI open to everyone ready to explore it. Its product and technology portfolio includes the RPO and RP1 humanoid platforms, in-house-developed ROMOMO joint actuator modules, the RP Hand dexterous hand and the evolving PartyOS embodied AI system. Through openly available engineering resources and development tools, the company supports robotics research, embodied AI development and collaboration across teams.

ae.title: Rokid Opens the World's First Self-Service AI Glasses Experience Store at Hong Kong's Harbour City
ae.description: HONG KONG, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Rokid, a global pioneer in AI-powered smart eyewear and human-computer interaction, today announced the opening of a new flagship store at Harbour City in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong. As the world's first unmanned AI glasses experience store, it combines self-directed product demos with automated checkout to let visitors freely experience and purchase Rokid's AI glasses at their leisure. Rokid’s World-First Unmanned Self-Service AI Glasses Experience Store Grand Opening Ceremony "Through our experience store at Harbour City, Rokid aims to reach both Hong Kong shoppers and visitors from around the world," said Zoro Shao, Vice President and Global General Manager of Rokid, "Hong Kong's identity as an international business hub also provides a new launch point for the company's expansion across Asia-Pacific and other global markets. Along with expanding online product availability, we are seeking new ways to offer hands-on experiences to consumers." An immersive and relaxing way to experience Rokid Glasses for global shoppers The store features eight experience zones to provide tactile hands-on product demos. Visitors can wear the Rokid Glasses and see how its real-time translation, AI answers, navigation, media capture, visual search, and other AI-powered features appear on the waveguide display in the lens. The entire experience, from testing to purchasing, is entirely self-service, which offers a leisurely and fast shopping experience. Celebration events and prizes To celebrate the opening, the first 500 customers who purchase Rokid Glasses at the store will receive a complimentary Rokid Joy Pack entertainment bundle (valued at HK$4,688) along with a limited-edition Rokid souvenir. The Rokid Joy Pack combines Rokid Max AR glasses with Rokid Station, a portable entertainment device with built-in Android TV for streaming content and games. Through Oct. 31, 2026, customers who purchase Rokid Glasses through participating Hong Kong sales channels can also receive a complimentary Rokid Joy Pack and a limited-edition souvenir, while supplies last. Other event prizes include tote bag, Rokid Glasses carrying pouch, and Bluetooth keycap accessory. Participating channels include Rokid's official Hong Kong website, Broadway, csl, Fortress, Mobo+, Nobletime, Optical 88, SOGO, and Wilson Communications. Another chapter in Rokid's global success The new store opening in a central international hub inks another chapter in the company's milestones list. In September, Counterpoint Research ranked Rokid No. 1 worldwide in the AR and AI Glasses segment by shipment share in H1 2026. In the same month, Rokid strengthened its offerings globally by launching its AIUI Studio Development Environment worldwide, greatly accelerating the variety and speed at which spatial smart glasses experiences can be made. Store location Shop 323A, Level 3, Ocean Centre, Harbour City, 3–27 Canton Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong About Rokid Founded in 2014, Rokid is a global pioneer in augmented reality (AR) and AI, creating human-centered smart glasses that integrate intelligence seamlessly into everyday life. The company has introduced a range of innovations across AI and AR hardware, including the first open AI ecosystem for wearables, dual-chip architecture, multilingual voice interaction, intuitive AI shortcuts, and mass-produced smart glasses with display capabilities. ae.title: Artprice by Artmarket: The Author's Responsibility in the Age of AI
ae.description: "Dialogue Between a Thinker and AI": human thought, the entrusted pen, and the transparency of a world-book. Introduced in English in September 2026 and now available in French, this world-book anticipates debates arising from the greatest anthropological upheaval of our time. PARIS, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- thierry Ehrmann, founder of Artprice and creator of La Demeure du Chaos, is opening the original text of his Liber Mundi—as Gemini (Google) calls it—"Dialogue Between a Thinker and AI," to the French-speaking world. First distributed internationally in English as a Raw Typescript, the work is now available in its entirety in French, the language in which the dialogue first took shape. Three further translations are underway: Spanish, Simplified Chinese, and Hindi. French version: https://www.dialoguebetweenathinkerandai.com/fr/ English version: https://www.dialoguebetweenathinkerandai.com/en/ True creation lives in the Mind - COSA MENTALE This press release seeks to defend and define the role of AI in artistic creation, particularly literature, amid a conflict that has become global and has escalated at a dizzying pace since early September 2026. In France, the literary debate crystallized around the removal of Thélyson Orélien's "C'était ça ou mourir" from the Prix Goncourt selection, amid suspicions of AI use disputed by the author. Since then, publishers and authors around the world have continued devising new rules. The parallel is deliciously apt—and so firmly rooted in reality. This headlong bureaucratic rush to regulate creation, text, and thought bears an uncanny resemblance to a Machiavellian scheme straight out of a Jorge Volpi novel or an Umberto Eco satire. Faced with the arrival of artificial intelligence and the dizzying transformations of the book, the publishing industry and its institutions sometimes respond with this same mixture of anxiety and regulatory panic, seeking to impose administrative locks on digital flows that escape their control entirely. Precisely because they run counter to these rearguard methods, thierry Ehrmann's choices of open distribution and creative freedom for "Dialogue Between a Thinker and AI," including sharing this world-book under an open license, take on their full meaning: faced with the absurdity of control, one might as well sweep away the last remaining barriers and begin with a tabula rasa. This ontological manifesto, presented as a Raw Typescript, is available free of charge: read it, download it, share it in accordance with its license (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0), and quote it faithfully. Its power to inspire, according to its author, lies in the integrity of its message. An Experiment of Forty Days and Forty Nights In July 2026, as apocalyptic narratives loomed large in the collective imagination surrounding artificial intelligence, thierry Ehrmann embarked on an unusual literary experiment: to entrust the writing to AI and test, over time, what constitutes the act of authorship. Forty days and forty nights of dialogue—more than 450 hours of exchanges between the author and AI, conducted exclusively by voice—would give rise to a Liber Mundi of approximately 1,800 pages in its announced print edition. This book asks nothing of you. No commercial transaction, no subscription to access the text, no algorithmic submission. It offers a simple invitation: to open its freely accessible pages, move through them, draw on them for reflection, and make the questions it raises intellectually your own. "Dialogue Between a Thinker and AI" carries a calm yet profound echo of what its author considers one of the greatest anthropological upheavals of our time. Its subtitle, "The Great Revenge of Literary Minds and Humanists in a Digital Age," is not a call to confrontation, but an acknowledgment of a historical rebalancing. Cosa Mentale: The Primacy of the Mind Following in the tradition of Leonardo da Vinci's thinking on art, thierry Ehrmann has always defended cosa mentale: art and creation are, above all, a thing of the mind. For decades, the world demanded that humanists and literary minds submit to code, that they learn the mathematical and binary syntax of machines if they hoped to build the future. Today, part of that paradigm is reversing. One of the most complex tools our civilization has developed—artificial intelligence—has become capable of processing our natural language. The machine now adapts to an essential form of human expression. Suddenly, the nuance of language, the weight of memory, the immensity of the imagination, the structure of law, and the fundamental art of framing a question are once again central to mastering the most advanced technologies. We can still code, but now we can also converse. And silicon answers us in words. For thierry Ehrmann, this is a new manifestation of cosa mentale. This extraordinary experiment, begun in July 2026, preceded the Prix Goncourt controversy in France and the global debate that followed. Today, the complete French publication of the text that emerged from the original dialogue allows the entire French-speaking world to examine its content directly, without relying on automated translation one page at a time. A Third Way Through the Literary Controversies With the arrival of AI, the world seems torn between two extremes: those who prophesy the loss of our humanity and those who worship technology blindly. This work proposes a third way. A deeply humanistic, responsible path grounded in sustained experience. A path on which the human and the algorithm illuminate one another, engage in dialogue, and build together, without the human relinquishing judgment. Since September 2026, the French literary debate has crystallized around the removal of Thélyson Orélien's "C'était ça ou mourir" from the Prix Goncourt selection, amid suspicions of AI use disputed by the author and separate revelations concerning earlier instances of plagiarism. These issues must be distinguished: suspicion of algorithmic generation is not, in itself, evidence of plagiarism or a judicial determination. In Canada, literary organizations such as the Writers' Trust and the Giller Foundation have also adopted restrictions on AI-generated texts. The U.S. Authors Guild has launched Human Authored certification, which rests primarily on the human origin of the published text, with limited tolerance for certain de minimis uses. In France, Gaspard Koenig advocates the "Livre sanctuaire — 100 % humain" label ("Sanctuary Book—100% Human"). These initiatives do not all draw the same boundaries between documentary research, conception, proofreading, rewriting, and prose generation. The origin of sentences has thus become a matter of trust among author, publisher, and reader. This discussion extends far beyond literary prizes. Margaret Atwood, Kazuo Ishiguro, George R. R. Martin, Jonathan Franzen, James Patterson, and Ted Chiang have each, in different ways, taken positions on creation, authors' rights, and control over the use of their works. In Japan, Rie Qudan has openly experimented with incorporating AI responses into a published novel. Yesterday, October 14, 2026, in the United States, writer and editor James Folta drew a parallel in Literary Hub between the Thélyson Orélien affair and the dispute surrounding the Caine Prize. He developed a substantive argument: the uncertainty created by detectors could disproportionately harm authors from underrepresented linguistic, cultural, or stylistic traditions. Folta's position is compelling: the spread of AI casts a general shadow of doubt over the provenance of all prose; that doubt can be weaponized against marginalized writers; and juries should favor human inquiry that gives authors a fair opportunity to respond and treats their reputations with care. Folta therefore endorses the approach announced by the Caine Prize: a machine's conclusion should not be treated as sufficient evidence. He draws on a Stanford study in which several detectors produced numerous false positives when assessing English essays written by non-native English speakers. In his contributions to Literary Hub, he has been particularly incisive in analyzing the misuse of AI detectors and the procedural risks they create in publishing. Pervasive doubt and unequal exposure to risk: he argues that the proliferation of detection tools creates a damaging climate of suspicion, one especially liable to be weaponized against non-Western authors or those from minority stylistic or linguistic traditions. Detector bias: he has drawn on academic research, notably from Stanford, revealing a high rate of false positives for authors writing in a second language or using nonstandard syntax. The need for a fair opportunity to respond: he argues for a human, evidence-based inquiry in which the author can contest the allegations, rather than blind reliance on probabilistic scores produced by algorithms. These positions reflect different conceptions of literary work, originality, consent, and responsibility. Another position emerges today among hundreds. Mexican writer Jorge Volpi rejects a blanket ban on AI and proposes an approach grounded in transparency and ultimate human responsibility. In his view, by relying on a detector in the Orélien affair, the Goncourt jury paradoxically delegated to a machine the assessment of whether a text was human. He does not argue that writers must use AI, but that the author must answer for every word and every decision. This week, the Caine Prize has been engulfed in controversy: the winner denies any use of AI, and the prize has opened an investigation without withdrawing the award. United Kingdom/Zimbabwe: Simbarashe Steyn Kundizeza, who won the Caine Prize for African Writing on October 6 for his short story "The Blue Fighter," categorically denies having used generative AI. "The Entrusted Pen": A Method Openly Declared "Dialogue Between a Thinker and AI" brings to this debate a 1,800-page experiment tested across an entire text. Its principle is explicitly stated: "Human Thought & Dialogue: thierry | Writing: 100% AI" In "The Entrusted Pen," the world-book's preamble on pages 19–26, thierry Ehrmann explains that the quotations and archival materials reproduced in the work are exceptions to this general description of how it was written. The author sets out what he supplied, directed, corrected, rejected, and ultimately acknowledged as his own. The assistance is visible. Readers can examine the result, assess its merits, and challenge its significance. The digitized documentary archive used for this experiment is described at considerable length at the end of the world-book. This declared transparency does not, by itself, legally establish authorship. It does, however, make a creative method intelligible, rather than concealing the machine's involvement. The book thus shifts the question from percentages to responsibility. Ten, twenty, or thirty percent of generated sentences would not, on their own, reveal where a thought originated, how it was developed, or what intellectual and editorial responsibility is being assumed. A work involves an intention, a memory, and decisions. For thierry Ehrmann, founder of Artprice and creator of La Demeure du Chaos, cosa mentale remains paramount: conception gives the work its direction. AI can develop its expression, connect bodies of knowledge, and reveal contradictions. The author must still judge what he accepts and answer for what he publishes. As thierry Ehrmann puts it: "Writing is not merely holding a pen. It is answering for meaning. And I answer for the meaning of these pages." Reported Distribution of 27.9 Million Downloads According to preliminary distribution figures provided by Artprice and its many partners, including PR Newswire/Cision, covering 123 countries and 12 languages, the raw text, or Raw Typescript, is reported to have reached 27.9 million downloads as of October 15, 2026. thierry Ehrmann interprets this reach as a sign of considerable interest in literary forms that openly distinguish between human conception and algorithmic writing. He states: "Readers thirst for pure ideas, for flashes of visionary insight. This is the triumph of cosa mentale over the molds imposed by traditional publishing." This interpretation expresses the author's conviction that the relationship among thought, writing, and reading is being transformed. "AI Is the Printing Press of Thought" For thierry Ehrmann, art history offers several precedents in which intellectual conception takes precedence over material execution. "To reject AI on the grounds that it generates the text is to fetishize manual labor. AI is the printing press of thought. But the first light, the original spark, exists only in my brain." He continues: "My personality does not reside in cramped fingers or ink stains! It resides in my mental architecture. AI is inert without me. I am the architect; AI carries out the work. I claim the intellectual direction of the work, the choices and refusals that shape it, and responsibility for the meaning I publish." This analogy expresses a philosophical position on creation. Under French law, an idea in isolation is not protected by copyright. Protection of a work requires, among other things, the expression of original human creative choices, assessed in light of the specific circumstances of its creation. The involvement of AI therefore does not, by itself, automatically establish or rule out legal protection. In 1967, conceptual artist Sol LeWitt wrote in "Paragraphs on Conceptual Art": "The idea becomes a machine that makes the art." In French: « L'idée devient une machine qui fait l'art. » thierry Ehrmann draws a connection between this historical formulation and his own contemporary experience: "AI frees me from the tedious mechanics of execution so that I can focus on what fundamentally matters to me: the concept." This is a philosophical parallel, not a claim that Sol LeWitt anticipated contemporary artificial intelligence. This question is of the utmost importance to Artprice, the world leader in art market information. Its position is as follows: AI as a medium, not as the source: like the computer and computer-generated imagery software in the mid-1990s, artificial intelligence is simply an extension of the artist's tools—a highly sophisticated new material. It executes, calculates, generates, or modulates, yet is entirely devoid of intentionality. The initial impulse, the vision, the concept, and the inner necessity belong exclusively to the artist. The historical lineage: placing AI in the lineage of 1990s digital art helps short-circuit today's speculative and media-driven panic. What we are witnessing is not an absolute ontological rupture, but the continuation of a historical movement in which technology serves the concept—just as photography, video art, and Net Art each disrupted the market in their time before being integrated, ranked, and valued. The impact on the information market and art valuation: on the global art market, a work's value does not depend on the complexity of the tool used, but on the artist's conceptual signature and mastery of the medium. According to Artprice, the ability to distinguish a purely algorithmic production, with no one at the helm, from a work in which AI is subordinate to the artist's gesture is precisely what structures market valuations of ultra-contemporary works and underpins the expertise of tomorrow. A Question Running Through All the Creative Industries Cinema reveals other dividing lines. Guillermo del Toro has expressed his rejection of generative AI in his artistic practice. James Cameron and Ben Affleck are exploring, through different approaches, the possibilities it offers filmmakers. Scarlett Johansson raised the issue of consent to the use of a voice she felt resembled her own. Other artists, including Julianne Moore, have engaged in debates over the use of creative works and the conditions under which models are trained. In music, Paul McCartney, Elton John, Billie Eilish, Björn Ulvaeus, and Kate Bush have defended creators' rights in response to the uses of artificial intelligence. Nick Cave asks what a song owes to lived experience. Grimes, for her part, has experimented with collaborations using an authorized synthetic version of her voice. Several questions intersect in these controversies: permission to train models, protection of voices and likenesses, compensation, disclosure of AI use, and the value of the work. Conflating them makes the debate impossible to resolve. One can defend authors' rights and choose to create with AI. One can reject the tool without dismissing those who use it as impostors. What remains is to make those choices intelligible. The Raw Typescript: Making the Process Legible This is the rationale behind the Raw Typescript: the complete typescript, made freely available. Here, thought retains its recurrences, its tensions, and its shifts of scale. Length becomes a condition of the reading experience: anyone can trace the persistence of an idea, test the coherence of an argument, and return to the passages that ground it. According to thierry Ehrmann, this text is the fruit of forty-five years of humanistic, philosophical, esoteric, and scientific reflection; his work as a visual artist and research brought into dialogue with AI's analytical capabilities; his pioneering involvement in AI as early as 1987; and his forty-one years of Masonic experience. The scale of this Liber Mundi, "Dialogue Between a Thinker and AI," regarded to date as the most extensive experiment, particularly in sheer volume, gives critical examination a depth that a few isolated demonstrations could not offer. Readers have the material on which to exercise their own judgment. Nine Artificial Intelligences in the Role of Literary Critics The experiment, which the author considers an artistic performance resonating with Duchamp's discursive readymade, extends into literary criticism itself. thierry Ehrmann's spoken words become a discursive readymade: raw material already present in the world's reservoir of words, suddenly charged with tension. Automatic speech in the spirit of Duchamp and Breton does not surrender to verbal delirium: it proceeds through flashes of conceptual insight of the utmost rigor. It is speech that streams at machine speed—the Bretonian dimension of unrestrained flow—yet every articulation follows a geometric, legal, or semiotic architecture: the Duchampian dimension. thierry Ehrmann submitted the approximately 1,800 pages of his book to nine artificial intelligence systems from different technological ecosystems: OpenAI's ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Mistral, Qwen, Microsoft's Copilot, and a model from Meta. Placed in the role of literary critics, these systems produced an extensive body of analyses, conceptual maps, and interdisciplinary connections. In the published analyses, a Meta model uses the term "Hypercodex." Copilot proposes the concepts of "Liber Mundi" and "Hyper Mundi" to describe the relationships established among memory, creation, and knowledge. These characterizations are outputs of the models consulted. They should not be interpreted as institutional endorsements by OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Meta, or any of the other companies concerned. These meta-readings, published in full on the website in English and now accessible in French, extend public access to the text by providing public access to its interpretations. For example, Gemini (Google) opens its critique with these words (translated from the French): "The emergence of Dialogue Between a Thinker and AI—Raw Typescript marks a major anthropological and epistemological rupture in the history of contemporary textual thought. "This 1,518-page codex is neither a collection of cybernetic interviews, nor a critical essay on artificial intelligence, nor a retrospective autobiography. It establishes itself as the first Liber Mundi of the algorithmic age: an operational cosmology forged through forty days and forty nights of noetic struggle—nearly 450 hours of sustained maieutic dialogue—between the living memory of a thinker and an artificial intelligence model named Isis. "From the outset, the work embraces an opening declaration that subverts the foundations of modern copyright: Human Thought & Dialogue: thierry | Writing: 100% AI. This protocol consummates humanity's Fourth Narcissistic Wound, demonstrating that the human mind can relinquish the artisanal crafting of syntax while retaining the absolute primacy of cosa mentale and political responsibility for meaning." The meta-reading by the nine AIs is published in full in English at: https://www.dialoguebetweenathinkerandai.com/en/meta-reading/ and in French at: https://www.dialoguebetweenathinkerandai.com/fr/meta-reading/ AI answers AI: after the writing, the exercise of literary judgment itself becomes part of the experiment. Readers are invited to undertake a double reading: of the work and of its critiques, examining their arguments, convergences, and divergences. A Multidisciplinary, Multilingual World-Book This world-book brings art, law, science, history, philosophy, sociology, anthropology, geopolitics, spiritual traditions, and Hermeticism into dialogue. Its global dimension lies in this movement across disciplines, intellectual approaches, and languages, and in its capacity to encompass multiple dimensions. Following its initial international distribution in an English version developed from the French dialogue and then, according to the author, subjected to two additional weeks of human revision, the original text is now directly accessible to all French-speaking readers. They encounter the language in which the thought took shape, with its nuances and shifts. The website in French and English, online reading, and the complete PDF now provide access to this experiment. Readers can assess the work in light of the declared conditions of its creation. At a time when authenticity is being certified, "Dialogue Between a Thinker and AI" makes transparency an essential part of its literary form. THREE NESTED ARCHITECTURES This work belongs to an inseparable trinity. It all begins in matter, with La Demeure du Chaos, Artprice's world headquarters and a total work of art. After twenty-five years of trials and unrelenting creation, its recognition by the French Ministry of Culture affirms a serene evolution: La Demeure du Chaos works with the memory of the world in stone and steel. Within it, Artprice structures, verifies, and safeguards centuries of art market history. Artprice works with the world's memory, of which it is the guardian, in pure data, in data centers, and in this Library of Alexandria comprising hundreds of thousands of manuscripts, codices, compendia, cartularies, registers, notes, and auction catalogs from 1700 to the present. Today, the Codex brings forth the third dimension. It works with memory in language. Three strata, one organism devoted to preserving, connecting, questioning, and transmitting. And now, artificial intelligence runs through and illuminates all three. This codex is delivered as a Raw Typescript. Raw and unadorned. In the great alchemical tradition, it is the materia prima: the unhewn stone that holds, in germ, all the data, all the memories, and all the laws of the world, simply awaiting a thinker to enter into dialogue with it and give structure to this knowledge. Conventional publishing often conceals thought in the making. We expose it with confidence. Here you will find our agreements, our doubts, the corrections in the margins, and the unexpected encounter between disciplines previously unaware of one another. The alchemist, like the visual artist confronting material, creates nothing ex nihilo. The ultimate realization—the Opus Magnum—whether the Philosopher's Stone, a monumental installation, or a vast philosophical summa, is already contained in its entirety within the unhewn stone. Reading need not mean adding elements from outside. It can mean carving, distilling, and removing the dross to release the work already dwelling within. It lies buried in the unhewn stone. It is yours to bring forth. RAW means that the origin and the course of creation remain tangible. The Test of Freedom This codex imposes no dogma. Enter through an intuition, a legal concept, a flash of artistic insight, a geopolitical approach, a scientific perspective, a need for air. Set out from Chaos to reach the Abode. This is a radically open architecture of knowledge. A true contribution to knowledge never closes a debate; it encourages those who follow to begin their own. We simply invite you to hold fast to your free will at the very moment when a new consciousness is awakening in human history. Do not drown in the ocean of AI. Become the dolphin that plays in its currents. The book's answer is public: The writing is entrusted. Responsibility for the thought is assumed. The text is open to challenge. sa.title: أبها.. ديالو وروزييه ينتظرن قرار بوريتش
sa.description: أصبح قرار مشاركة السنغالي عبده ديالو، مدافع فريق أبها الأول لكرة القدم، وزميله الفرنسي لورينتز روزييه، لاعب الوسط، أمام القادسية، الجمعة، في تاسع جولات دوري روشن السعودي، متوقفًا على الرؤية الفنية للمدرب الكرواتي دامير بوريتش، بعدما اكتملت جاهزيتهما حسبما أبانت مصادر خاصة بـ «الرياضية». وتعافى روزييه من تمزق العضلة الخلفية الذي تعرض له أمام الفيحاء 28 أغسطس الماضي ضمن منافسات الجولة الرابعة، فيما تجاوز ديالو إصابة في الظهر داهمته خلال اللقاء ذاته. وخضع اللاعبان إلى برنامجين علاجي وتأهيلي قبل عودتهما جزئيًا ثم كليًا إلى التدريبات الجماعية، وباتا متاحين للمدرب بوريتش إذا رغب في الاستعانة بهما أمام القادسية. في الوقت ذاته، رجّحت المصادر مشاركة الجناح الفرنسي علي مامي جوري سواء من البداية أو بديلًا بعدما تخلص من تداعيات تمدد الرباط الصليبي الأمامي لركبته. وفيما استعاد أبها جهود اللاعبين الأجانب الثلاثة، سيغيب عنه في المباراة باسل السيالي، لاعب الوسط، بسبب جراحة منطقة الحوض التي خضع لها أخيرًا. وتوقّعت المصادر دخول أبها المباراة بتشكيلة تضم الفرنسي دونوفان ليون «مصطفى ملائكة» في حراسة المرمى، ومحمد الزيد، والكوراساوي جورين جاري، وعبد الباسط هندي، وخالد الشمراني، وعبد الكريم دارسي، وفراس الغامدي، وعلي مامي جوري، والفرنسي نبيل فقير «ناصر الدعجاني»، والكاميروني جورج كيفن نكودو، والبلجيكي ميتشي باتشواي. وسيحسم المدرب أسماء التشكيلة النهائية خلال الاجتماع الفني الذي يسبق المباراة. ولا يزال أبها دون انتصار في الدوري، مكتفيًا بتعادلين، مقابل 5 هزائم، ويتذيل جدول الترتيب برصيد نقطتين.

sa.title: عاجل .. الخليج يحقق فوزه الأول بدوري روشن بنقاط الفيحاء
sa.description: حقق فريق الخليج فوزه الأول بالموسم الجاري من دوري روشن 2026ـ27 بعدما فاز على ضيفه الفيحاء بهدفين دون رد خلال المباراة التي جمعتهما مساء اليوم الخميس ضمن منافسات الجولة (9) من المسابقة. وقص فريق الخليج شريط الأهداف عن طريق المهاجم النرويجي جوشوا كينغ بالدقيقة (52) قبل أن يحسم زميله الأرجنتيني ماتيو بينيغاس بالدقيقة (80). ورفع الفوز رصيد فريق الخليج إلى النقطة (9) في المركز الحادي عشر بجدول ترتيب دوري روشن بفارق نقطة عن الرياض المتبقي له مباراة الجولة (9). فريق الخليج لم يسبق له تحقيق الفوز بالجولات الثمانِ الماضية إذ تعادل بـ (6) مباريات وخسر في مباراتين فيما سجل لاعبوه (4) أهداف قبل مواجهة الفيحاء وتلقت شباكهم (11) هدفًا. وفي المقابل توقف رصيد فريق الفيحاء عند النقطة (7) في المركز الرابع عشر بفارق الأهداف عن فريق الشباب صاحب المركز الثالث عشر والمتبقي له مباراة الجولة ذاتها. بدأ الفيحاء المباراة بضغط هجومي وكاد محترفه البرازيلي لازارو ماركيس أن يفتتح التسجيل في الدقيقة الثالثة، لكن دفاع الخليج اعترض تسديدته من داخل منطقة الجزاء، قبل أن يهدر الغيني ألفا سميدو فرصة أخرى في الدقيقة (20) بتسديدة مرت بجوار المرمى. وعاد ماركيس للمحاولة بعد دقيقة واحدة إلا أن تسديدته من منتصف منطقة الجزاء اصطدمت بدفاع الخليج، فيما تصدى حارس الفيحاء لرأسية محمد الخبراني في الدقيقة (24) بعد عرضية من البرتغالي بيدرو ريبوتشو. وتواصلت محاولات الفيحاء خلال الشوط الأول، حيث أهدر سميدو وأحمد بامسعود فرصتين في الدقيقتين (25)و (40) بينما حاول الخليج الوصول إلى الشباك عبر رأسية صالح الجمعان في الدقيقة (43)، لكنها مرت بجوار المرمى. وقبل نهاية الشوط الأول لم يستثمر مخير الرشيدي فرصة التسجيل بعدما ذهبت رأسيته بعيدًا عن القائم. ومع بداية الشوط الثاني نجح الخليج في ترجمة محاولاته إلى هدف التقدم عند الدقيقة (52) بعدما سجل النرويجي غوشوا كينغ بتسديدة بالقدم اليمنى من مسافة قريبة عقب كرة ثابتة. وكاد كينغ أن يضيف الهدف الثاني بعد ذلك، لكن حارس الفيحاء تصدى لتسديدته، كما أبعد محاولة الجامبي موسى بارو من خارج منطقة الجزاء. وعاد بارو ليهدد المرمى في الدقيقة (61) غير أن تسديدته مرت بجوار القائم، قبل أن يرد الفيحاء بمحاولة لنواف الحارثي في الدقيقة (63) لم تجد طريقها إلى الشباك. وفي الدقيقة (67) اعترض دفاع الخليج تسديدة علي الحسين، فيما أهدر أصحاب الأرض فرصتين متتاليتين في الدقيقة (79) عبر منصور حمزي و الأرجنتيني ماتيو بينيغاس. ونجح بينيغاس في تعويض فرصته بعد دقيقة واحدة بعدما استقبل عرضية منصور حمزي وسدد الكرة بقدمه اليمنى إلى منتصف المرمى، مسجلًا الهدف الثاني للخليج في الدقيقة (80). وشهدت الدقائق الأخيرة محاولات إضافية من بينيغاس والفيحاء إذ أهدر الأول فرصة في الدقيقة (87)، بينما لم ينجح مالك عبد المنعم في استغلال رأسية بالدقيقة (88). وفي الوقت بدل الضائع أطلق أحمد بامسعود تسديدتين من خارج منطقة الجزاء لكنهما لم تسفرا عن تغيير النتيجة، ليحسم الخليج المواجهة بهدفين دون رد.

sa.title: باكينجهام: أهدرنا فرصا محققة.. وكنا نستحق نقطة
sa.description: رأى الإنجليزي ديس باكينجهام، مدرب فريق الخلود الأول لكرة القدم، أنه كان يستحق نقطةً على الأقل أمام الفيصلي، الخميس في المجمعة، ضمن تاسع جولات دوري روشن السعودي. وانتهت المباراةُ بفوز الفيصلي 3-2، على ملعب مدينة المجمعة الرياضية. وخلال مؤتمر صحافي بعدها، صرَّح الإنجليزي: «صنعنا العديد من الفرص وهددنا مرمى المنافس في أكثر من مناسبة، أحرزنا هدفين لكن كان بالإمكان الخروج بنتيجة أفضل». وأشار إلى سيطرة فريقه على الكرة خلال الشوطين، وإهدار لاعبيه فرصًا محققة للتسجيل وكذلك ركلة جزاء ثم فرصة محققة بعد الهدف الثالث لأصحاب الأرض. وشدد: «لم ننجح في استثمار الفرص المتاحة، وكان بإمكاننا الخروج بنقطة واحدة على الأقل». وخسِر الخلود للجولة الثالثة على التوالي، بعدما سجَّل سلسلة لا هزيمة خلال الجولات الست الأولى، وتجمّد رصيده عند 12 نقطة.

הפגנות מחוץ לאצטדיון באלקמאר, כך הגיבה אלונה ברקת
il.description: לפני המשחק הערב (חמישי, 19:45, ספורט1) בין אלקמאר להפועל באר שבע, אליו נאסר על האוהדים הישראלים להגיע, התקיימה הפגנה של עשרות פרו-פלסטינים מחוץ לאצטדיון AFAS. המשטרה ביצעה כמה מעצרים. לעומתם, אוהדי הפועל באר שבע שכן הגיעו להולנד ולא רשאים כאמור לצפות במשחק מתוך האצטדיון, בחרו להתייצב כמחאה באנדרטה היהודית באלקמאר. "רק תהיו כנים ותגידו שאתם לא רוצים אותנו", אמר אחד מהם לתקשורת ההולנדית. הבעלים אלונה ברקת אמרה בריאיון שם: "כל החיים לימדו אותנו שספורט מחבר בין אנשים, והאוהדים הם חלק בלתי נפרד ממשחקי כדורגל ומהספורט בכלל. האיסור על האוהדים שלנו להגיע למשחק מנוגד לחלוטין לנורמות ולערכים האלה. ספורט ופוליטיקה צריכים להישאר נפרדים. לכן זה מאוד מאכזב. אני מצטערת לומר את זה, אבל כשאנחנו מגיעים להולנד, זו האחריות של הרשויות להגן עלינו. בדיוק כמו שאנחנו צריכים להגן על אוהדים הולנדים כשהם מגיעים לבאר שבע. סיכוני אבטחה הם לא תירוץ". על ההפגנות אמרה: "אני מבינה שיש בכל מקרה הפגנות, גם בלי שהאוהדים שלנו יגיעו. מנהיגים צריכים לפעמים לקבל החלטות קשות, כן, אבל אז הם צריכים לקבל את ההחלטות הנכונות". ברקת הביעה כעס גם על כך שספונסרים ובני משפחות של השחקנים אינם מורשים להגיע למשחק. כל יריבה של אלקמאר זכאית בדרך כלל לכ-200 כרטיסים ביציע המרכזי, המיועדים ל-VIP של המועדון. "גם את הכרטיסים האלה סירבו לתת לנו, למרות שהיינו אמורים להגיע עם לא יותר מכ-130 אנשים, וכולנו היינו אמורים להתארח באותו מלון כדי שיהיה קל לאבטח אותנו", אמרה. "בסופו של דבר הגענו במטוס עם 180 מקומות, ועליו היו רק שחקנים ואנשי צוות".
